About this item

  • QHD Resolution (2560 x 1440) has 1.7 times the pixel density of Full HD for incredibly detailed pinsharp images
  • HDR10 provides brighter highlights and nuanced shadow for added depth - making every scene feel more vivid and realistic
  • The 180Hz refresh rate minimizes lag for gameplay with ultra-smooth action. Plus, the 1ms response time helps capture your moves in real-time, allowing you to react fast for gaming precision

Customer ReviewWatch Before Buying - Samsung 27" Odyssey G5 (G51F) MonitorSee Full Review

Product Description

Epic screen. Epic play. Step into a game world that’s more vivid and immersive than ever before with the Samsung 27" Odyssey G5 Gaming Monitor. Boasting 1.7 times the pixel density of Full HD, QHD Resolution (2560 x 1440) offers true-to-life display visuals that boost your game’s realism. Enjoy lifelike visuals with improved contrast and color accuracy thanks to HDR10 which provides this video monitor with brighter highlights and nuanced shadow, adding depth that makes every scene feel more vivid and realistic. The 180Hz refresh rate minimizes lag while the 1ms response time (MPRT) helps this monitor capture your moves in real-time, together producing exhilarating gameplay that allows you to react fast for unbeatable gaming precision. You’ll be immersed in smooth action with minimal distraction as AMD FreeSync reduces choppiness, gaming screen lag, and image tearing to produce seamless gameplay that allows you to stay ahead of the competition. Even when your enemies are hiding in the deepest shadow, Black Equalizer allows you to adjust any dark areas on the 27-inch gaming monitor so you can locate opponents hiding in the corners. Coming with an ergonomic stand that allows for tilt, pivot and height adjustments, gaming comfort is maximized even during extended sessions.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
